claims.text: The datasets used for evaluation are CSAT, 20 newsgroups, and Fisher.
The CSAT dataset consists of US English telephone speech from call centers, with 4331 calls split into training, validation, and testing sets.
The 20 newsgroups dataset contains approximately 20,000 English documents for topic identification.
The Fisher dataset is used for topic identification and is mentioned as having strong results in the study.
